label: Bible Study
prompt: Be _____ for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
verse: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
note: 'Careful' is KJV for 'anxious' — trade the worry for prayer with thanksgiving.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will _____; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
verse: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
note: Before they call, I will answer — God's reply is on the way before the prayer is finished.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed _____.
verse: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.
note: For Jesus' Jewish listeners, feeding swine was rock bottom — exactly where the prodigal son landed.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered _____ fire before the LORD, which he commanded them not.
verse: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which he commanded them not.
note: Aaron's sons improvised at the altar the day the priesthood began; the very next verse shows how seriously God took it.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a _____ cord is not quickly broken.
verse: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
note: 'A threefold cord' — a wedding-sermon favorite, usually unpacked as husband, wife, and God.
